spec.charge: 1/n_held_before of the monthly book, name's own return from the weekly drop session to the monthly drop session

answers.residual_source: E70 weeklyclash cost face (full weekly grid vs month-end, x0/x3 residual, 2020 start)

honest: the tail is priced as name return x equal weight over the extra sessions; it is not a re-run of either book's P&L, so it cannot double-count the calendar gaps E65-E69 already priced
an event needs a priced base at the weekly drop session and a priced close at the monthly drop session; unpriced ends are counted in skipped.unpriced instead of being charged as a flat hold
names held by the monthly book that never appear in the weekly book are counted in skipped.never_in_weekly_book and excluded -- they are not a stale tail, they are a coverage difference
events are charged once each, at the decision that sees the exit, so a name that enters and exits repeatedly contributes several events
bp_per_year divides the window total by the calendar span, which understates a concentrated tail in a short era and overstates a tail diluted over a long one -- read it beside per-era totals
the -45bp residual is quoted from the E70 face as published; no attempt is made here to recompute it
descriptive census only: no gate, no verdict, no ledger booking, trial 0
